name: Naturalisation (Non-Commonwealth Nationals)

requirements.blocker_text: Naturalisation is open only to nationals of non-Commonwealth countries; Commonwealth citizens, Irish citizens, and British protected persons instead use the registration route (see tt_registration_commonwealth.json).
Requires 12 months' residence immediately preceding the application, plus an aggregate of 5 years' residence (or qualifying government service) during the 7 years before that 12-month period.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 12 months immediately preceding application, plus 5 of the prior 7 years.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires adequate knowledge of the English language and understanding of the duties and responsibilities of citizenship.

evidence_required.document: Document Checklist (per Ministry of Homeland Security)

sources.title: Citizenship of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago Act, Chapter 1:50 (primary legislation, privately hosted mirror of the official text): naturalisation limited to non-Commonwealth nationals, 12-months-plus-5-of-7-years residence formula, good character, English/civics knowledge, Minister's discretion to relax the 12-month timing, Oath of Allegiance

Ministry of Homeland Security, Government of Trinidad and Tobago -- Naturalised Citizenship: confirms non-Commonwealth-only eligibility per the Immigration Act, Document Checklist, no published fee or detailed process on this page

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Trinidad and Tobago's initial build. Treated the Citizenship Act's text (Chapter 1:50) as tier 1 despite being hosted on a private (non-.gov.tt) mirror site, since it is the verbatim primary legislation rather than a secondary summary or interpretation -- flagged here so this judgment call is visible; re-verify against the official Ministry of the Attorney General and Legal Affairs 'Laws of Trinidad and Tobago' portal if a more authoritative copy is needed. The non-Commonwealth-only eligibility rule is a distinctive, easy-to-miss gate: most Caribbean, UK, Canadian, Australian, and other Commonwealth-country nationals CANNOT use this route at all and must use registration instead (see tt_registration_commonwealth.json) -- modelled as a hard blocking requirement rather than a note, since it determines which of the two routes applies before residence/character even come into play. No fee amount was found on either source.
